speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) seeks to promote sustained non-inflationary economic growth and foster a trusted and resilient financial sector and will continue to do so amid the increasing global uncertainties and new risks.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: With increasing global fragmentation, we must be ready for major shifts in production and supply chains.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MAS will stay vigilant to the impact of these developments on growth and inflation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MAS will uphold Singapore’s standing as a trusted financial centre through robust supervision and risk-proportionate regulation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will continue to work with the financial industry and other Government agencies to protect Singapore’s financial system from illegal activities.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will consider other safeguards to fight scams, such as stronger user authentication to prevent unauthorised transactions.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: On consumer protection, MAS has updated its Fair Dealing Guidelines to raise standards and improve the experience of customers dealing with financial institutions.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We have also launched a Basic Financial Planning Guide to strengthen consumer education and help individuals take action to address savings, insurance and investment needs across life stages.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Singapore’s financial sector continues to see broad-based growth.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MAS will continue to work with financial institutions to deepen capabilities across key asset classes such as banking, foreign exchange, insurance, asset and wealth management and payments.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MAS will support financial institutions in building capabilities to adopt AI technologies in financial services, through the Financial Sector Technology and Innovation Grant Scheme.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Industry collaborations, like the Pathfinder programme, will allow financial institutions to exchange insights and share experiences, including on AI use cases, and provide greater clarity on the responsible use of AI.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also upskill the financial sector workforce to work effectively with AI.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MAS will continue to facilitate industry efforts to expand the use of tokenisation in financial assets transactions, to achieve greater efficiency and lower cost.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our plans include (a) forming broader commercial networks to deepen liquidity of tokenised assets; (b) facilitating interoperability across digital asset market infrastructures; (c) fostering standardised industry frameworks for tokenised asset implementation and adoption; and (d) enabling access to common settlement facility for tokenised assets.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MAS remains committed to support Asia’s transition to a low-carbon economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: This blended finance model will seek to attract more funding for sustainable infrastructure in the region.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MAS will ensure that our workforce is equipped to navigate increasing complexities in the financial sector.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Sustainable Finance Jobs Transformation Map has identified the skills that our workforce will need to support the growing sustainable finance market.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will continue to stay vigilant to risks and developments in global markets that affect Singapore and ensure that the financial system remains resilient and competitive.
